# teams agent blueprint permissions remove

Revoke delegated scope(s) on a resource app from a blueprint and stop them from being inherited

## Usage

```
teams agent blueprint permissions remove <blueprintId> <scopes> [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `blueprintId` | Agent blueprint (application) ID | Yes |
| `scopes` | Comma-separated delegated scope names (e.g. Mail.ReadWrite,Chat.ReadWrite) | Yes |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--resource <name>` | [OPTIONAL] Resource app the scopes belong to: "graph", "smba", "powerplatform", or a resource app ID (GUID). (default: `graph`) |
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
